## Approval request handler
Set a PostSider webhook subscription for `approval.requested` pointing at this Webhook node's production URL, then set the env var `POSTSIDER_WEBHOOK_SECRET` to the subscription secret.

The Approve and Reject nodes are DISABLED. Enable one only after you have decided who or what may decide. They need an API key with the `approvals:decide` scope (never granted by default). Do not wire them to unreviewed AI output.
